page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual instance provisioned on the KVM hypervisor using x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance features 32 dedicated vCPUs paired with 128 GB of RAM, resulting in a balanced allocation of 4 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is delivered by two NVIDIA P4 graphics processing units featuring a combined 16 GB of VRAM.

Network baseline performance for this instance is 6 Gbps. The server includes no local ephemeral storage, necessitating the use of remote network-attached block volumes for all persistent data operations. This structural design prioritizes virtual machine density and GPU compute delivery while offloading storage performance to network interfaces.

The dual-GPU configuration alongside moderate vCPU and memory density provides practical hardware efficiency for parallel computing tasks. Suitable workloads include video transcoding, multi-stream media processing, AI model inference, and general enterprise applications requiring specialized graphics acceleration.
